ko.title: 2026 회계연도 적자 마감: 2026년 적자 집계가 워싱턴의 차입에 대해 시사하는 점

segments.src: The federal government's 2026 fiscal year closed on September 30, and the official accounting is now arriving.
segments.tr: 연방 정부의 2026 회계연도가 9월 30일에 마감되었으며, 공식 회계 자료가 발표되고 있습니다.

segments.src: The Treasury Department publishes the final monthly statement, and the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) releases its own review of the year's results.
segments.tr: 재무부는 최종 월간 보고서를 발행하고, 의회예산국(CBO)은 해당 연도 결과에 대한 자체 검토 보고서를 발표합니다.

segments.src: Together they put a final number on the gap between what Washington collected and what it spent.
segments.tr: 이들은 워싱턴이 거둬들인 세입과 지출한 세출 사이의 격차에 대한 최종 수치를 제시합니다.

segments.src: The exact figure matters less than what is behind it.
segments.tr: 정확한 수치 자체보다는 그 이면에 무엇이 있는지 파악하는 것이 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: Check the Treasury's Monthly Treasury Statement and the CBO's budget review for the precise totals.
segments.tr: 정확한 총액은 재무부의 월간 재무 보고서(Monthly Treasury Statement)와 CBO의 예산 검토 보고서를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: This article explains how to read them.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 해당 자료를 읽는 방법을 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the deficit keeps showing up
segments.tr: ## 적자가 계속 발생하는 이유

segments.src: The federal government has run a deficit in nearly every year for decades.
segments.tr: 연방 정부는 수십 년 동안 거의 매년 적자를 기록해 왔습니다.

segments.src: A deficit is the one-year gap between revenue and spending.
segments.tr: 적자란 1년 동안의 세입과 세출 사이의 격차를 의미합니다.

segments.src: The national debt is the running total of those gaps, plus interest owed on past borrowing.
segments.tr: 국가 부채는 이러한 격차의 누적 합계에 과거 차입에 대한 이자를 더한 금액입니다.

segments.src: In recent years, the annual shortfall has stayed large even though the economy has been growing and unemployment has been relatively low.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년 동안 경제가 성장하고 실업률이 비교적 낮았음에도 불구하고 연간 재정 부족액은 여전히 큰 규모를 유지했습니다.

segments.src: That is unusual by historical standards.
segments.tr: 이는 역사적 기준에서 볼 때 이례적인 일입니다.

segments.src: Deficits typically shrink in good economic times.
segments.tr: 일반적으로 경제가 좋을 때는 적자가 줄어들기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## Interest costs are now a major driver
segments.tr: ## 이자 비용이 이제 주요 요인으로 작용

segments.src: The biggest change in the budget picture is the cost of servicing the debt.
segments.tr: 예산 상황에서 가장 큰 변화는 부채 상환 비용입니다.

segments.src: Net interest payments, meaning what the government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, have climbed sharply.
segments.tr: 순이자 지급액, 즉 정부가 벌어들이는 이자를 제외하고 차입금에 대해 지불하는 이자가 급격히 증가했습니다.

segments.src: The causes are straightforward:
segments.tr: 그 원인은 간단합니다:

segments.src: - **A larger debt.** More borrowed money means more interest owed, even at constant rates.
segments.tr: - **더 커진 부채.** 차입금이 많아지면 금리가 일정하더라도 지불해야 할 이자가 늘어납니다.

segments.src: - **Higher rates than in the 2010s.** Older, cheaper debt matures and is refinanced at today's higher yields.
segments.tr: - **2010년대보다 높은 금리.** 만기가 도래한 기존의 저금리 부채가 현재의 더 높은 수익률로 차환됩니다.

segments.src: - **Rolling over short-term debt.** A large share of Treasury debt is short-dated, so it reprices quickly when rates change.
segments.tr: - **단기 부채의 롤오버.** 재무부 부채의 상당 부분이 단기 채권이므로 금리가 변할 때 빠르게 재평가됩니다.

segments.src: In CBO projections, net interest has surpassed spending on national defense and now rivals or exceeds major programs.
segments.tr: CBO 전망에 따르면 순이자 비용은 국방비 지출을 넘어섰으며, 이제 주요 프로그램 예산과 맞먹거나 이를 상회합니다.

segments.src: Interest is not a policy choice that Congress votes on each year.
segments.tr: 이자는 의회가 매년 투표로 결정하는 정책적 선택 사항이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is a bill that comes due automatically.
segments.tr: 이는 자동으로 지불해야 하는 청구서와 같습니다.

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes
segments.tr: ## 이 집계가 세금에 의미하는 바

segments.src: A persistent deficit does not by itself force a tax change in any given year.
segments.tr: 지속적인 적자가 발생한다고 해서 반드시 특정 연도에 세금 변경이 강제되는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Washington can borrow from investors at auction.
segments.tr: 워싱턴은 경매를 통해 투자자들로부터 자금을 빌릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: But rising interest costs shrink the room for other priorities, and that shapes the tax debate in several ways:
segments.tr: 하지만 이자 비용 상승은 다른 우선순위를 위한 여력을 줄어들게 하며, 이는 여러 방식으로 세금 논쟁을 형성합니다:

segments.src: 1. **Expiring and extended provisions.** When Congress considers extending tax provisions, the cost of doing so is scored against deficit projections. Larger baseline deficits make those trade-offs sharper.
segments.tr: 1. **만료 및 연장 조항.** 의회가 세금 조항 연장을 고려할 때, 그 비용은 적자 전망치에 반영됩니다. 기준 적자가 커질수록 이러한 상충 관계는 더욱 날카로워집니다.

segments.src: 2. **Revenue versus spending framing.** Some lawmakers argue that revenue must rise. Others argue that spending must fall or that growth will close the gap. The final tally is used by both sides.
segments.tr: 2. **세입 대 세출 프레임.** 일부 의원들은 세입이 늘어야 한다고 주장합니다. 다른 의원들은 지출을 줄여야 하거나 성장을 통해 격차를 해소해야 한다고 주장합니다. 최종 집계는 양측 모두에 의해 사용됩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Tariff revenue.** Customs duties have become a larger line item. Analysts disagree about how durable that revenue is, given legal challenges and changes in trade policy.
segments.tr: 3. **관세 수입.** 관세는 더 큰 비중을 차지하는 항목이 되었습니다. 법적 문제와 무역 정책의 변화를 고려할 때, 분석가들은 이러한 수입이 얼마나 지속 가능할지에 대해 의견이 갈립니다.

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.
segments.tr: 개별 납세자는 단일 연도의 적자 수치로 인해 즉각적인 변화가 있을 것이라고 기대해서는 안 됩니다.

segments.src: Changes come through legislation, which can take a long time.
segments.tr: 변화는 입법을 통해 이루어지며, 이는 오랜 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for spending debates
segments.tr: ## 지출 논쟁에 의미하는 바

segments.src: Most of the budget is already committed.
segments.tr: 예산의 대부분은 이미 용도가 정해져 있습니다.

segments.src: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and net interest account for a large majority of federal outlays.
segments.tr: 사회보장제도, 메디케어, 메디케이드 및 순이자 비용이 연방 지출의 대다수를 차지합니다.

segments.src: The part Congress sets annually, called discretionary spending, is a smaller slice.
segments.tr: 의회가 매년 결정하는 재량 지출은 더 작은 비중을 차지합니다.

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: 여기에는 국방비와 연구, 교통, 교육과 같은 비국방 프로그램이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: 이자 비용이 증가함에 따라, 이는 재량 지출 예산과 경쟁하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: 연례 예산 배정 싸움은 다음과 같은 몇 가지 질문에 집중될 것으로 예상됩니다:

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - 지출 상한선이나 기타 재정 규칙을 사용해야 하는가?

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - 장기적인 성장을 늦추기 위해 조정해야 할 프로그램이 있는가?

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - 긴급 지출은 예산 내에서 어떻게 처리해야 하는가?

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## 차기 의회에 의미하는 바

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: 2027년 1월에 임기를 시작하는 차기 의회는 이러한 상황을 물려받게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 문제가 제기될 가능성이 높습니다:

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **정부 자금 지원 마감일.** 연례 예산 배정과 임시 조치 가능성.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **부채 한도.** 이전 입법이 어떻게 설정되었는지에 따라 차입 권한이 다시 논의될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **세금 및 복지 혜택 상충 관계.** 사회보장제도와 메디케어의 장기적인 신탁 기금 부족 문제는 예상 고갈 시기가 다가옴에 따라 주목받게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **업데이트된 전망.** 새로운 CBO 기준선은 모든 제안의 출발점을 재설정할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## 직접 수치를 읽는 방법

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: 최종 수치가 발표될 때, 몇 가지 습관이 도움이 됩니다:

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.
segments.tr: - **GDP 대비 비교.** 경제 규모 대비 적자 비율이 달러 금액 자체보다 더 의미가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **일회성 효과 분리.** 지급일이 주말에 겹치는 경우와 같은 시기적 변동은 회계연도 간 지출을 이동시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **기초 적자와 총 적자 구분.** 기초 적자는 이자를 제외합니다. 이는 격차 중 얼마나 많은 부분이 현재 정책 때문이고, 얼마나 많은 부분이 과거 차입 때문인지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.
segments.tr: - **원천 자료 사용.** 재무부, CBO, 관리예산처(OMB)는 데이터를 무료로 공개합니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The 2026 deficit tally is a snapshot of a longer pattern: spending commitments that exceed revenue, with interest costs adding to the pressure.
segments.tr: 2026년 적자 집계는 더 긴 패턴의 스냅샷입니다. 즉, 세입을 초과하는 지출 약속과 그에 따른 이자 비용이 압박을 가중시키고 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists differ about how worrying that is and what the right response should be.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 이것이 얼마나 우려스러운지, 그리고 올바른 대응이 무엇인지에 대해 의견이 다릅니다.

segments.src: What most agree on is that the arithmetic gets harder as interest takes a larger share of the budget.
segments.tr: 대부분이 동의하는 점은 이자가 예산에서 차지하는 비중이 커질수록 산술적인 계산이 더 어려워진다는 것입니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and is not tax, investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 세금, 투자 또는 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Figures and projections are revised regularly, so consult official sources for current data.*
segments.tr: 수치와 전망은 정기적으로 수정되므로 최신 데이터는 공식 출처를 참조하십시오.*

zh.title: 财政年度以赤字告终：2026年赤字统计数据揭示了华盛顿的借贷状况

segments.src: The federal government's 2026 fiscal year closed on September 30, and the official accounting is now arriving.
segments.tr: 联邦政府的2026财年于9月30日结束，官方核算数据现已出炉。

segments.src: The Treasury Department publishes the final monthly statement, and the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) releases its own review of the year's results.
segments.tr: 财政部发布了最终月度报表，国会预算办公室（CBO）也发布了其对年度结果的审查报告。

segments.src: Together they put a final number on the gap between what Washington collected and what it spent.
segments.tr: 它们共同为华盛顿的收入与支出之间的缺口确定了一个最终数字。

segments.src: The exact figure matters less than what is behind it.
segments.tr: 确切的数字并不重要，重要的是其背后的含义。

segments.src: Check the Treasury's Monthly Treasury Statement and the CBO's budget review for the precise totals.
segments.tr: 请查阅财政部的《月度财政报表》和CBO的预算审查以获取精确的总额。

segments.src: This article explains how to read them.
segments.tr: 本文将解释如何解读这些数据。

segments.src: ## Why the deficit keeps showing up
segments.tr: ## 为什么赤字持续存在

segments.src: The federal government has run a deficit in nearly every year for decades.
segments.tr: 几十年来，联邦政府几乎每年都出现赤字。

segments.src: A deficit is the one-year gap between revenue and spending.
segments.tr: 赤字是指一年内收入与支出之间的缺口。

segments.src: The national debt is the running total of those gaps, plus interest owed on past borrowing.
segments.tr: 国债是这些缺口的累计总额，外加过去借款所欠的利息。

segments.src: In recent years, the annual shortfall has stayed large even though the economy has been growing and unemployment has been relatively low.
segments.tr: 近年来，尽管经济一直在增长且失业率相对较低，但年度缺口依然巨大。

segments.src: That is unusual by historical standards.
segments.tr: 按历史标准来看，这很不寻常。

segments.src: Deficits typically shrink in good economic times.
segments.tr: 赤字通常会在经济形势良好时缩小。

segments.src: ## Interest costs are now a major driver
segments.tr: ## 利息成本现已成为主要驱动因素

segments.src: The biggest change in the budget picture is the cost of servicing the debt.
segments.tr: 预算状况中最大的变化是偿债成本。

segments.src: Net interest payments, meaning what the government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, have climbed sharply.
segments.tr: 净利息支出，即政府在扣除其赚取的利息后为借款支付的费用，已大幅攀升。

segments.src: The causes are straightforward:
segments.tr: 原因很简单：

segments.src: - **A larger debt.** More borrowed money means more interest owed, even at constant rates.
segments.tr: - **债务规模更大。** 借入的资金越多，意味着即使在利率不变的情况下，所欠的利息也越多。

segments.src: - **Higher rates than in the 2010s.** Older, cheaper debt matures and is refinanced at today's higher yields.
segments.tr: - **利率高于2010年代。** 旧的、成本较低的债务到期后，以当今更高的收益率进行再融资。

segments.src: - **Rolling over short-term debt.** A large share of Treasury debt is short-dated, so it reprices quickly when rates change.
segments.tr: - **短期债务展期。** 很大一部分国债是短期债务，因此当利率变化时，其重新定价的速度很快。

segments.src: In CBO projections, net interest has surpassed spending on national defense and now rivals or exceeds major programs.
segments.tr: 在CBO的预测中，净利息支出已超过国防支出，目前可与主要项目支出相媲美甚至更高。

segments.src: Interest is not a policy choice that Congress votes on each year.
segments.tr: 利息不是国会每年投票决定的政策选择。

segments.src: It is a bill that comes due automatically.
segments.tr: 这是一笔会自动到期的账单。

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes
segments.tr: ## 统计数据对税收意味着什么

segments.src: A persistent deficit does not by itself force a tax change in any given year.
segments.tr: 持续的赤字本身并不会迫使任何特定年份的税收发生变化。

segments.src: Washington can borrow from investors at auction.
segments.tr: 华盛顿可以通过拍卖向投资者借款。

segments.src: But rising interest costs shrink the room for other priorities, and that shapes the tax debate in several ways:
segments.tr: 但不断上升的利息成本压缩了其他优先事项的空间，这在几个方面影响了税收辩论：

segments.src: 1. **Expiring and extended provisions.** When Congress considers extending tax provisions, the cost of doing so is scored against deficit projections. Larger baseline deficits make those trade-offs sharper.
segments.tr: 1. **到期和延期的条款。** 当国会考虑延长税收条款时，这样做的成本会根据赤字预测进行评估。更大的基准赤字使这些权衡变得更加尖锐。

segments.src: 2. **Revenue versus spending framing.** Some lawmakers argue that revenue must rise. Others argue that spending must fall or that growth will close the gap. The final tally is used by both sides.
segments.tr: 2. **收入与支出的框架。** 一些议员认为必须增加收入。另一些人则认为必须削减支出，或者经济增长将弥补这一缺口。最终的统计数据被双方所利用。

segments.src: 3. **Tariff revenue.** Customs duties have become a larger line item. Analysts disagree about how durable that revenue is, given legal challenges and changes in trade policy.
segments.tr: 3. **关税收入。** 关税已成为一个更大的项目。鉴于法律挑战和贸易政策的变化，分析师对这些收入的持久性存在分歧。

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.
segments.tr: 个人纳税人不应指望单一年份的赤字数字会带来任何直接变化。

segments.src: Changes come through legislation, which can take a long time.
segments.tr: 变化是通过立法实现的，这可能需要很长时间。

segments.src: ## What it means for spending debates
segments.tr: ## 这对支出辩论意味着什么

segments.src: Most of the budget is already committed.
segments.tr: 大部分预算已经有了既定用途。

segments.src: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and net interest account for a large majority of federal outlays.
segments.tr: 社会保障、医疗保险、医疗补助和净利息占联邦支出的绝大部分。

segments.src: The part Congress sets annually, called discretionary spending, is a smaller slice.
segments.tr: 国会每年设定的部分，即酌情支出，所占比例较小。

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: 它涵盖了国防和非国防项目，如研究、交通和教育。

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: 随着利息成本的增长，它们与那部分酌情支出形成了竞争。

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: 预计年度拨款之争将集中在几个问题上：

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - 是否应该使用支出上限或其他财政规则？

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - 如果有的话，应该调整哪些项目以减缓长期增长？

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - 在预算内应如何处理紧急支出？

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## 这对下一届国会意味着什么

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: 将于2027年1月就职的下一届国会将继承这一局面。

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: 可能会出现几个问题：

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **政府资金截止日期。** 年度拨款和临时措施的可能性。

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **债务上限。** 取决于之前的立法如何设定，借贷授权可能会再次成为一个话题。

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **税收和福利的权衡。** 随着社会保障和医疗保险的预计耗尽日期临近，其长期信托基金的缺口将引起关注。

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **更新的预测。** 新的CBO基准将重置每一项提案的起点。

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## 如何亲自解读这些数字

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: 当最终数据出现时，养成一些习惯会有所帮助：

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.
segments.tr: - **与GDP进行比较。** 作为经济份额的赤字比单纯的美元金额更有意义。

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **区分一次性影响。** 时间上的转移，例如付款日期落在周末，可能会导致支出在不同财年之间变动。

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **查看基本赤字与总赤字。** 基本赤字不包括利息。它显示了缺口中有多少是由于当前政策造成的，又有多少是由于过去的借款造成的。

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.
segments.tr: - **使用原始来源。** 财政部、CBO和管理与预算办公室免费发布其数据。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The 2026 deficit tally is a snapshot of a longer pattern: spending commitments that exceed revenue, with interest costs adding to the pressure.
segments.tr: 2026年的赤字统计数据是一个更长模式的缩影：支出承诺超过收入，利息成本增加了压力。

segments.src: Economists differ about how worrying that is and what the right response should be.
segments.tr: 经济学家对于这有多令人担忧以及正确的应对措施是什么存在分歧。

segments.src: What most agree on is that the arithmetic gets harder as interest takes a larger share of the budget.
segments.tr: 大多数人同意的是，随着利息在预算中所占份额的增加，算术题变得越来越难。

segments.tr: 数字和预测会定期修订，因此请查阅官方来源以获取当前数据。*

segments.src: This article explains how to read them.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि उन्हें कैसे पढ़ा जाए.

segments.src: ## Why the deficit keeps showing up
segments.tr: ## घाटा क्यों लगातार सामने आ रहा है

segments.src: The federal government has run a deficit in nearly every year for decades.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार ने दशकों से लगभग हर साल घाटा दर्ज किया है।

segments.src: A deficit is the one-year gap between revenue and spending.
segments.tr: घाटा राजस्व और खर्च के बीच का एक साल का अंतर है।

segments.src: The national debt is the running total of those gaps, plus interest owed on past borrowing.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रीय ऋण उन अंतरालों का कुल योग है, साथ ही पिछले उधार पर देय ब्याज भी शामिल है.

segments.src: In recent years, the annual shortfall has stayed large even though the economy has been growing and unemployment has been relatively low.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में, अर्थव्यवस्था के बढ़ने और बेरोजगारी के अपेक्षाकृत कम होने के बावजूद वार्षिक घाटा बड़ा बना हुआ है।

segments.src: That is unusual by historical standards.
segments.tr: ऐतिहासिक मानकों के अनुसार यह असामान्य है।

segments.src: Deficits typically shrink in good economic times.
segments.tr: अच्छे आर्थिक समय में आमतौर पर घाटा कम होता है.

segments.src: ## Interest costs are now a major driver
segments.tr: ## ब्याज लागत अब एक प्रमुख कारक है

segments.src: The biggest change in the budget picture is the cost of servicing the debt.
segments.tr: बजट के मोर्चे पर सबसे बड़ा बदलाव ऋण चुकाने की लागत है।

segments.src: Net interest payments, meaning what the government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, have climbed sharply.
segments.tr: शुद्ध ब्याज भुगतान, जिसका अर्थ है कि सरकार द्वारा अर्जित ब्याज को घटाने के बाद वह अपने उधार पर कितना भुगतान करती है, में तेजी से वृद्धि हुई है।

segments.src: The causes are straightforward:
segments.tr: इसके कारण सीधे हैं:

segments.src: - **A larger debt.** More borrowed money means more interest owed, even at constant rates.
segments.tr: - **एक बड़ा ऋण।** अधिक उधार ली गई राशि का अर्थ है अधिक देय ब्याज, निरंतर दरों पर भी।

segments.src: - **Higher rates than in the 2010s.** Older, cheaper debt matures and is refinanced at today's higher yields.
segments.tr: - **2010 के दशक की तुलना में उच्च दरें।** पुराना, सस्ता ऋण परिपक्व हो जाता है और आज की उच्च पैदावार पर पुनर्वित्त किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Rolling over short-term debt.** A large share of Treasury debt is short-dated, so it reprices quickly when rates change.
segments.tr: - **अल्पकालिक ऋण को आगे बढ़ाना।** ट्रेजरी ऋण का एक बड़ा हिस्सा अल्पकालिक है, इसलिए दरों में बदलाव होने पर यह जल्दी से अपनी कीमत तय करता है।

segments.src: In CBO projections, net interest has surpassed spending on national defense and now rivals or exceeds major programs.
segments.tr: CBO के अनुमानों में, शुद्ध ब्याज ने राष्ट्रीय रक्षा पर खर्च को पार कर लिया है और अब प्रमुख कार्यक्रमों की बराबरी करता है या उनसे अधिक है।

segments.src: Interest is not a policy choice that Congress votes on each year.
segments.tr: ब्याज कोई नीतिगत विकल्प नहीं है जिस पर कांग्रेस हर साल वोट करती है।

segments.src: It is a bill that comes due automatically.
segments.tr: यह एक ऐसा बिल है जो स्वचालित रूप से देय हो जाता है.

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes
segments.tr: ## करों के लिए इस आंकड़े का क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: A persistent deficit does not by itself force a tax change in any given year.
segments.tr: लगातार बना रहने वाला घाटा अपने आप में किसी दिए गए वर्ष में कर परिवर्तन के लिए मजबूर नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Washington can borrow from investors at auction.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन नीलामी में निवेशकों से उधार ले सकता है।

segments.src: But rising interest costs shrink the room for other priorities, and that shapes the tax debate in several ways:
segments.tr: लेकिन बढ़ती ब्याज लागत अन्य प्राथमिकताओं के लिए जगह को सिकोड़ देती है, और यह कई तरीकों से कर बहस को आकार देती है:

segments.src: 1. **Expiring and extended provisions.** When Congress considers extending tax provisions, the cost of doing so is scored against deficit projections. Larger baseline deficits make those trade-offs sharper.
segments.tr: 1. **समाप्त होने वाले और विस्तारित प्रावधान।** जब कांग्रेस कर प्रावधानों को बढ़ाने पर विचार करती है, तो ऐसा करने की लागत को घाटे के अनुमानों के मुकाबले परखा जाता है। बड़े बेसलाइन घाटे उन ट्रेड-ऑफ़ को और अधिक तीव्र बनाते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Revenue versus spending framing.** Some lawmakers argue that revenue must rise. Others argue that spending must fall or that growth will close the gap. The final tally is used by both sides.
segments.tr: 2. **राजस्व बनाम खर्च का ढांचा।** कुछ सांसदों का तर्क है कि राजस्व बढ़ना चाहिए। अन्य लोगों का तर्क है कि खर्च कम होना चाहिए या विकास अंतर को पाट देगा। अंतिम आंकड़े का उपयोग दोनों पक्षों द्वारा किया जाता है।

segments.src: 3. **Tariff revenue.** Customs duties have become a larger line item. Analysts disagree about how durable that revenue is, given legal challenges and changes in trade policy.
segments.tr: 3. **टैरिफ राजस्व।** सीमा शुल्क एक बड़ी पंक्ति मद बन गए हैं। कानूनी चुनौतियों और व्यापार नीति में बदलाव को देखते हुए विश्लेषक इस बात से असहमत हैं कि वह राजस्व कितना टिकाऊ है।

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत करदाताओं को एक ही वर्ष के घाटे की संख्या से किसी भी तत्काल बदलाव की उम्मीद नहीं करनी चाहिए।

segments.src: Changes come through legislation, which can take a long time.
segments.tr: परिवर्तन कानून के माध्यम से आते हैं, जिसमें काफी समय लग सकता है.

segments.src: ## What it means for spending debates
segments.tr: ## खर्च की बहसों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Most of the budget is already committed.
segments.tr: बजट का अधिकांश हिस्सा पहले से ही प्रतिबद्ध है।

segments.src: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and net interest account for a large majority of federal outlays.
segments.tr: सामाजिक सुरक्षा, मेडिकर, मेडिकेड और शुद्ध ब्याज संघीय परिव्यय के एक बड़े बहुमत के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं।

segments.src: The part Congress sets annually, called discretionary spending, is a smaller slice.
segments.tr: वह हिस्सा जिसे कांग्रेस सालाना तय करती है, जिसे विवेकाधीन खर्च कहा जाता है, एक छोटा हिस्सा है।

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: यह अनुसंधान, परिवहन और शिक्षा जैसे रक्षा और गैर-रक्षा कार्यक्रमों को कवर करता है.

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे ब्याज लागत बढ़ती है, वे उस विवेकाधीन हिस्से के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: उम्मीद है कि वार्षिक विनियोग की लड़ाई कुछ सवालों पर केंद्रित होगी:

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - क्या खर्च की सीमा या अन्य राजकोषीय नियमों का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए?

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - दीर्घकालिक विकास को धीमा करने के लिए किन कार्यक्रमों, यदि कोई हों, को समायोजित किया जाना चाहिए?

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - बजट के भीतर आपातकालीन खर्च का इलाज कैसे किया जाना चाहिए?

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## अगली कांग्रेस के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: अगली कांग्रेस, जो जनवरी 2027 में पदभार ग्रहण करेगी, को यह तस्वीर विरासत में मिलेगी।

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: कई मुद्दे सामने आने की संभावना है:

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **सरकारी वित्त पोषण समय सीमा।** वार्षिक विनियोग और अंतरिम उपायों की संभावना।

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **ऋण सीमा।** पिछले कानून ने इसे कैसे निर्धारित किया है, उसके आधार पर उधार लेने का अधिकार फिर से एक विषय बन सकता है।

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **कर और पात्रता ट्रेड-ऑफ़।** सामाजिक सुरक्षा और मेडिकर में दीर्घकालिक ट्रस्ट फंड की कमियां ध्यान आकर्षित करेंगी क्योंकि उनकी अनुमानित कमी की तारीखें नजदीक आ रही हैं।

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **अद्यतन अनुमान।** नए CBO बेसलाइन हर प्रस्ताव के लिए शुरुआती बिंदु को रीसेट करेंगे।

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## संख्याओं को स्वयं कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: जब अंतिम आंकड़े सामने आते हैं, तो कुछ आदतें मदद करती हैं:

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.

es.title: El año fiscal termina en números rojos: qué dice el recuento del déficit de 2026 sobre el endeudamiento de Washington

segments.src: The federal government's 2026 fiscal year closed on September 30, and the official accounting is now arriving.
segments.tr: El año fiscal 2026 del gobierno federal concluyó el 30 de septiembre y ya está llegando la contabilidad oficial.

segments.src: The Treasury Department publishes the final monthly statement, and the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) releases its own review of the year's results.
segments.tr: El Departamento del Tesoro publica la declaración mensual final y la Oficina de Presupuesto del Congreso (CBO) emite su propia revisión de los resultados del año.

segments.src: Together they put a final number on the gap between what Washington collected and what it spent.
segments.tr: Juntos asignan una cifra final a la brecha entre lo que Washington recaudó y lo que gastó.

segments.src: The exact figure matters less than what is behind it.
segments.tr: La cifra exacta importa menos que lo que hay detrás de ella.

segments.src: Check the Treasury's Monthly Treasury Statement and the CBO's budget review for the precise totals.
segments.tr: Consulte el Estado Mensual del Tesoro y la revisión presupuestaria de la CBO para ver los totales precisos.

segments.src: This article explains how to read them.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica cómo leerlos.

segments.src: ## Why the deficit keeps showing up
segments.tr: ## Por qué el déficit sigue apareciendo

segments.src: The federal government has run a deficit in nearly every year for decades.
segments.tr: El gobierno federal ha tenido déficit en casi todos los años durante décadas.

segments.src: A deficit is the one-year gap between revenue and spending.
segments.tr: Un déficit es la brecha de un solo año entre los ingresos y los gastos.

segments.src: The national debt is the running total of those gaps, plus interest owed on past borrowing.
segments.tr: La deuda nacional es el total acumulado de esas brechas, más los intereses adeudados por endeudamiento pasado.

segments.src: In recent years, the annual shortfall has stayed large even though the economy has been growing and unemployment has been relatively low.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, el déficit anual se ha mantenido elevado a pesar de que la economía ha estado creciendo y el desempleo ha sido relativamente bajo.

segments.src: That is unusual by historical standards.
segments.tr: Eso es inusual según los estándares históricos.

segments.src: Deficits typically shrink in good economic times.
segments.tr: Los déficits suelen reducirse en los buenos tiempos económicos.

segments.src: ## Interest costs are now a major driver
segments.tr: ## Los costos de intereses son ahora un factor clave

segments.src: The biggest change in the budget picture is the cost of servicing the debt.
segments.tr: El mayor cambio en el panorama presupuestario es el costo de servicio de la deuda.

segments.src: Net interest payments, meaning what the government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, have climbed sharply.
segments.tr: Los pagos netos de intereses, es decir, lo que el gobierno paga por su endeudamiento tras restar los intereses que gana, se han elevado drásticamente.

segments.src: The causes are straightforward:
segments.tr: Las causas son sencillas:

segments.src: - **A larger debt.** More borrowed money means more interest owed, even at constant rates.
segments.tr: - **Una deuda más grande.** Más dinero prestado significa más intereses adeudados, incluso con tasas constantes.

segments.src: - **Higher rates than in the 2010s.** Older, cheaper debt matures and is refinanced at today's higher yields.
segments.tr: - **Tasas más altas que en la década de 2010.** La deuda más antigua y barata vence y se refinancia a los rendimientos más altos de hoy.

segments.src: - **Rolling over short-term debt.** A large share of Treasury debt is short-dated, so it reprices quickly when rates change.
segments.tr: - **Refinanciación de deuda a corto plazo.** Una gran parte de la deuda del Tesoro es a corto plazo, por lo que se reajusta rápidamente cuando cambian las tasas.

segments.src: In CBO projections, net interest has surpassed spending on national defense and now rivals or exceeds major programs.
segments.tr: En las proyecciones de la CBO, los intereses netos han superado el gasto en defensa nacional y ahora rivalizan o superan a programas principales.

segments.src: Interest is not a policy choice that Congress votes on each year.
segments.tr: El interés no es una decisión política que el Congreso vota cada año.

segments.src: It is a bill that comes due automatically.
segments.tr: Es una factura que vence automáticamente.

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa el recuento para los impuestos

segments.src: A persistent deficit does not by itself force a tax change in any given year.
segments.tr: Un déficit persistente no fuerza por sí solo un cambio fiscal en un año determinado.

segments.src: Washington can borrow from investors at auction.
segments.tr: Washington puede pedir prestado a inversores en subastas.

segments.src: But rising interest costs shrink the room for other priorities, and that shapes the tax debate in several ways:
segments.tr: Pero el aumento de los costos de intereses reduce el margen para otras prioridades, y eso da forma al debate fiscal de varias maneras:

segments.src: 1. **Expiring and extended provisions.** When Congress considers extending tax provisions, the cost of doing so is scored against deficit projections. Larger baseline deficits make those trade-offs sharper.
segments.tr: 1. **Disposiciones que vencen y se extienden.** Cuando el Congreso considera extender disposiciones fiscales, el costo de hacerlo se evalúa frente a las proyecciones de déficit. Déficits de referencia más grandes hacen que esas compensaciones sean más drásticas.

segments.src: 2. **Revenue versus spending framing.** Some lawmakers argue that revenue must rise. Others argue that spending must fall or that growth will close the gap. The final tally is used by both sides.
segments.tr: 2. **Enfoque de ingresos frente a gastos.** Algunos legisladores argumentan que los ingresos deben aumentar. Otros sostienen que el gasto debe bajar o que el crecimiento cerrará la brecha. El recuento final es utilizado por ambas partes.

segments.src: 3. **Tariff revenue.** Customs duties have become a larger line item. Analysts disagree about how durable that revenue is, given legal challenges and changes in trade policy.
segments.tr: 3. **Ingresos por aranceles.** Los derechos de aduana se han convertido en un rubro más grande. Los analistas no están de acuerdo sobre qué tan duraderos son esos ingresos, dados los desafíos legales y los cambios en la política comercial.

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.
segments.tr: Los contribuyentes individuales no deben esperar ningún cambio inmediato del número de déficit de un solo año.

segments.src: Changes come through legislation, which can take a long time.
segments.tr: Los cambios se producen a través de la legislación, lo que puede llevar mucho tiempo.

segments.src: ## What it means for spending debates
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los debates sobre el gasto

segments.src: Most of the budget is already committed.
segments.tr: La mayor parte del presupuesto ya está comprometida.

segments.src: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and net interest account for a large majority of federal outlays.
segments.tr: El Seguro Social, Medicare, Medicaid y los intereses netos representan la gran mayoría de los desembolsos federales.

segments.src: The part Congress sets annually, called discretionary spending, is a smaller slice.
segments.tr: La parte que el Congreso fija anualmente, llamada gasto discrecional, es una porción más pequeña.

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: Cubre defensa y programas no defensivos como investigación, transporte y educación.

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: A medida que crecen los costos de intereses, compiten con esa porción discrecional.

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: Es de esperar que las disputas presupuestarias anuales se centren en algunas preguntas:

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - ¿Deberían usarse límites de gasto u otras reglas fiscales?

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - ¿Qué programas, si los hay, deberían ajustarse para frenar el crecimiento a largo plazo?

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - ¿Cómo debería tratarse el gasto de emergencia dentro del presupuesto?

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para el próximo Congreso

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: El próximo Congreso, que asume el cargo en enero de 2027, heredará este panorama.

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: Es probable que surjan varios temas:

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **Plazos de financiación del gobierno.** Asignaciones anuales y la posibilidad de medidas provisionales.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **El límite de la deuda.** Dependiendo de cómo lo estableció la legislación anterior, la autoridad de endeudamiento puede volver a ser un tema de discusión.

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **Compensaciones fiscales y de derechos.** Los déficits a más largo plazo en los fondos fiduciarios del Seguro Social y Medicare atraerán la atención a medida que se acerquen sus fechas proyectadas de agotamiento.

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **Proyecciones actualizadas.** Las nuevas referencias de la CBO restablecerán el punto de partida de cada propuesta.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer los números usted mismo

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: Cuando aparecen las cifras finales, algunos hábitos ayudan:

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.
segments.tr: - **Comparar con el PIB.** Un déficit como porcentaje de la economía es más significativo que solo la cifra en dólares.

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **Separar los efectos puntuales.** Los desajustes temporales, como cuando la fecha de un pago cae en fin de semana, pueden desplazar el gasto entre años fiscales.

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **Observar el déficit primario frente al total.** El déficit primario excluye los intereses. Muestra cuánto de la brecha se debe a la política actual y cuánto se debe al endeudamiento pasado.

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.
segments.tr: - **Utilizar fuentes originales.** El Tesoro, la CBO y la Oficina de Administración y Presupuesto publican sus datos de forma gratuita.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The 2026 deficit tally is a snapshot of a longer pattern: spending commitments that exceed revenue, with interest costs adding to the pressure.
segments.tr: El recuento del déficit de 2026 es una instantánea de un patrón más prolongado: compromisos de gasto que superan los ingresos, con los costos de intereses añadiendo presión.

segments.src: Economists differ about how worrying that is and what the right response should be.
segments.tr: Los economistas difieren sobre qué tan preocupante es esto y cuál debería ser la respuesta adecuada.

segments.src: What most agree on is that the arithmetic gets harder as interest takes a larger share of the budget.
segments.tr: En lo que la mayoría coincide es en que la aritmética se vuelve más difícil a medida que los intereses absorben una porción mayor del presupuesto.

segments.tr: *Este artículo es para información general y no constituye asesoramiento fiscal, de inversión o financiero.

segments.tr: Las cifras y proyecciones se revisan habitualmente, por lo que debe consultar las fuentes oficiales para obtener datos actualizados.*

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **Le plafond de la dette.** Selon la manière dont la législation précédente l'a fixé, l'autorisation d'emprunt pourrait redevenir un sujet.

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **Séparer les effets ponctuels.** Les décalages temporels, comme lorsqu'une date de paiement tombe un week-end, peuvent déplacer les dépenses d'un exercice à l'autre.

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **Examiner le déficit primaire par rapport au déficit total.** Le déficit primaire exclut les intérêts. Il montre quelle part de l'écart est due à la politique actuelle et quelle part est due aux emprunts passés.

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.

segments.src: ## The bottom line

segments.src: The 2026 deficit tally is a snapshot of a longer pattern: spending commitments that exceed revenue, with interest costs adding to the pressure.

pt.title: O Ano Fiscal Termina no Vermelho: O que o Saldo do Déficit de 2026 Diz Sobre o Endividamento de Washington

segments.src: The federal government's 2026 fiscal year closed on September 30, and the official accounting is now arriving.
segments.tr: O ano fiscal de 2026 do governo federal encerrou-se em 30 de setembro, e a contabilidade oficial está chegando agora.

segments.src: The Treasury Department publishes the final monthly statement, and the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) releases its own review of the year's results.
segments.tr: O Departamento do Tesouro publica o demonstrativo mensal final, e o Congressional Budget Office (CBO) divulga sua própria revisão dos resultados do ano.

segments.src: Together they put a final number on the gap between what Washington collected and what it spent.
segments.tr: Juntos, eles estabelecem um número final para a diferença entre o que Washington arrecadou e o que gastou.

segments.src: The exact figure matters less than what is behind it.
segments.tr: O número exato importa menos do que o que está por trás dele.

segments.src: Check the Treasury's Monthly Treasury Statement and the CBO's budget review for the precise totals.
segments.tr: Verifique o Monthly Treasury Statement do Tesouro e a revisão orçamentária do CBO para os totais precisos.

segments.src: This article explains how to read them.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica como lê-los.

segments.src: ## Why the deficit keeps showing up
segments.tr: ## Por que o déficit continua aparecendo

segments.src: The federal government has run a deficit in nearly every year for decades.
segments.tr: O governo federal tem apresentado déficit em quase todos os anos há décadas.

segments.src: A deficit is the one-year gap between revenue and spending.
segments.tr: Um déficit é a diferença de um ano entre receita e despesa.

segments.src: The national debt is the running total of those gaps, plus interest owed on past borrowing.
segments.tr: A dívida nacional é o total acumulado dessas diferenças, mais os juros devidos sobre empréstimos passados.

segments.src: In recent years, the annual shortfall has stayed large even though the economy has been growing and unemployment has been relatively low.
segments.tr: Nos últimos anos, o déficit anual permaneceu grande, mesmo com a economia crescendo e o desemprego relativamente baixo.

segments.src: That is unusual by historical standards.
segments.tr: Isso é incomum pelos padrões históricos.

segments.src: Deficits typically shrink in good economic times.
segments.tr: Os déficits normalmente diminuem em bons tempos econômicos.

segments.src: ## Interest costs are now a major driver
segments.tr: ## Os custos com juros são agora um fator importante

segments.src: The biggest change in the budget picture is the cost of servicing the debt.
segments.tr: A maior mudança no cenário orçamentário é o custo do serviço da dívida.

segments.src: Net interest payments, meaning what the government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, have climbed sharply.
segments.tr: Os pagamentos líquidos de juros, significando o que o governo paga sobre seus empréstimos após subtrair os juros que ganha, subiram drasticamente.

segments.src: The causes are straightforward:
segments.tr: As causas são simples:

segments.src: - **A larger debt.** More borrowed money means more interest owed, even at constant rates.
segments.tr: - **Uma dívida maior.** Mais dinheiro emprestado significa mais juros devidos, mesmo com taxas constantes.

segments.src: - **Higher rates than in the 2010s.** Older, cheaper debt matures and is refinanced at today's higher yields.
segments.tr: - **Taxas mais altas do que na década de 2010.** Dívidas mais antigas e baratas vencem e são refinanciadas aos rendimentos mais altos de hoje.

segments.src: - **Rolling over short-term debt.** A large share of Treasury debt is short-dated, so it reprices quickly when rates change.
segments.tr: - **Rolagem de dívida de curto prazo.** Uma grande parcela da dívida do Tesouro é de curto prazo, portanto, ela é precificada rapidamente quando as taxas mudam.

segments.src: In CBO projections, net interest has surpassed spending on national defense and now rivals or exceeds major programs.
segments.tr: Nas projeções do CBO, os juros líquidos superaram os gastos com defesa nacional e agora rivalizam ou excedem os principais programas.

segments.src: Interest is not a policy choice that Congress votes on each year.
segments.tr: Os juros não são uma escolha política sobre a qual o Congresso vota a cada ano.

segments.src: It is a bill that comes due automatically.
segments.tr: É uma conta que vence automaticamente.

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes
segments.tr: ## O que o saldo significa para os impostos

segments.src: A persistent deficit does not by itself force a tax change in any given year.
segments.tr: Um déficit persistente não força, por si só, uma mudança tributária em qualquer ano específico.

segments.src: Washington can borrow from investors at auction.
segments.tr: Washington pode tomar emprestado de investidores em leilão.

segments.src: But rising interest costs shrink the room for other priorities, and that shapes the tax debate in several ways:
segments.tr: Mas o aumento dos custos com juros reduz o espaço para outras prioridades, e isso molda o debate tributário de várias maneiras:

segments.src: 1. **Expiring and extended provisions.** When Congress considers extending tax provisions, the cost of doing so is scored against deficit projections. Larger baseline deficits make those trade-offs sharper.
segments.tr: 1. **Disposições expiradas e estendidas.** Quando o Congresso considera estender disposições fiscais, o custo de fazê-lo é calculado em relação às projeções de déficit. Déficits básicos maiores tornam essas compensações mais acentuadas.

segments.src: 2. **Revenue versus spending framing.** Some lawmakers argue that revenue must rise. Others argue that spending must fall or that growth will close the gap. The final tally is used by both sides.
segments.tr: 2. **Enquadramento de receita versus despesa.** Alguns legisladores argumentam que a receita deve aumentar. Outros argumentam que a despesa deve cair ou que o crescimento fechará a lacuna. O saldo final é usado por ambos os lados.

segments.src: 3. **Tariff revenue.** Customs duties have become a larger line item. Analysts disagree about how durable that revenue is, given legal challenges and changes in trade policy.
segments.tr: 3. **Receita tarifária.** Os direitos aduaneiros tornaram-se uma rubrica maior. Os analistas discordam sobre quão durável é essa receita, dados os desafios legais e as mudanças na política comercial.

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.
segments.tr: Os contribuintes individuais não devem esperar nenhuma mudança imediata a partir do número do déficit de um único ano.

segments.src: Changes come through legislation, which can take a long time.
segments.tr: As mudanças ocorrem por meio de legislação, o que pode levar muito tempo.

segments.src: ## What it means for spending debates
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para os debates sobre gastos

segments.src: Most of the budget is already committed.
segments.tr: A maior parte do orçamento já está comprometida.

segments.src: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and net interest account for a large majority of federal outlays.
segments.tr: A Previdência Social (Social Security), o Medicare, o Medicaid e os juros líquidos representam a grande maioria das despesas federais.

segments.src: The part Congress sets annually, called discretionary spending, is a smaller slice.
segments.tr: A parte que o Congresso define anualmente, chamada de gastos discricionários, é uma fatia menor.

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: Ela cobre programas de defesa e não relacionados à defesa, como pesquisa, transporte e educação.

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: À medida que os custos com juros crescem, eles competem com essa fatia discricionária.

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: Espere que as lutas anuais por dotações orçamentárias se concentrem em algumas questões:

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - Devem ser usados tetos de gastos ou outras regras fiscais?

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - Quais programas, se houver, devem ser ajustados para desacelerar o crescimento de longo prazo?

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - Como os gastos de emergência devem ser tratados dentro do orçamento?

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para o próximo Congresso

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: O próximo Congresso, que assume o cargo em janeiro de 2027, herdará este cenário.

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: Várias questões provavelmente surgirão:

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **Prazos de financiamento do governo.** Dotações anuais e a possibilidade de medidas provisórias.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **O limite da dívida.** Dependendo de como a legislação anterior o definiu, a autoridade para empréstimos pode se tornar um tópico novamente.

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **Compensações de impostos e benefícios.** Déficits de longo prazo nos fundos fiduciários da Previdência Social e do Medicare atrairão atenção à medida que suas datas projetadas de esgotamento se aproximam.

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **Projeções atualizadas.** Novas linhas de base do CBO redefinirão o ponto de partida para cada proposta.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## Como ler os números você mesmo

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: Quando os números finais aparecerem, alguns hábitos ajudam:

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.
segments.tr: - **Compare com o PIB.** Um déficit como parcela da economia é mais significativo do que apenas o valor em dólares.

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **Separe efeitos únicos.** Mudanças de cronograma, como quando uma data de pagamento cai em um fim de semana, podem mover gastos entre anos fiscais.

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **Observe o déficit primário versus o total.** O déficit primário exclui juros. Ele mostra quanto da lacuna se deve à política atual e quanto se deve a empréstimos passados.

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.
segments.tr: - **Use fontes originais.** O Tesouro, o CBO e o Escritório de Gestão e Orçamento publicam seus dados gratuitamente.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A conclusão

segments.src: The 2026 deficit tally is a snapshot of a longer pattern: spending commitments that exceed revenue, with interest costs adding to the pressure.
segments.tr: O saldo do déficit de 2026 é um retrato de um padrão mais longo: compromissos de gastos que excedem a receita, com os custos de juros aumentando a pressão.

segments.src: Economists differ about how worrying that is and what the right response should be.
segments.tr: Os economistas divergem sobre o quão preocupante isso é e qual deveria ser a resposta correta.

segments.src: What most agree on is that the arithmetic gets harder as interest takes a larger share of the budget.
segments.tr: O que a maioria concorda é que a aritmética fica mais difícil à medida que os juros ocupam uma parcela maior do orçamento.

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.

ja.title: 財政年度が赤字で終了：2026年の財政赤字の集計がワシントンの借入れについて語ること

segments.src: The federal government's 2026 fiscal year closed on September 30, and the official accounting is now arriving.
segments.tr: 連邦政府の2026財政年度は9月30日に終了し、公式な会計報告が現在出揃いつつあります。

segments.src: The Treasury Department publishes the final monthly statement, and the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) releases its own review of the year's results.
segments.tr: 財務省は最終的な月次報告書を公表し、非党派の予算局（CBO）はその年の結果に関する独自のレビューを発表します。

segments.src: Together they put a final number on the gap between what Washington collected and what it spent.
segments.tr: これらを合わせることで、ワシントンが徴収した歳入と支出した歳出の差額に対する最終的な数字が示されます。

segments.src: The exact figure matters less than what is behind it.
segments.tr: 正確な数値そのものよりも、その背景にある要因の方が重要です。

segments.src: Check the Treasury's Monthly Treasury Statement and the CBO's budget review for the precise totals.
segments.tr: 正確な合計額については、財務省の月次財政報告書（Monthly Treasury Statement）およびCBOの予算レビューを確認してください。

segments.src: This article explains how to read them.
segments.tr: この記事では、それらの読み方について解説します。

segments.src: ## Why the deficit keeps showing up
segments.tr: ## なぜ赤字が常に発生するのか

segments.src: The federal government has run a deficit in nearly every year for decades.
segments.tr: 連邦政府は、数十年にわたりほぼ毎年のように財政赤字を計上してきました。

segments.src: A deficit is the one-year gap between revenue and spending.
segments.tr: 赤字とは、歳入と歳出の間の1年間の差額のことです。

segments.src: The national debt is the running total of those gaps, plus interest owed on past borrowing.
segments.tr: 国債（国家債務）とは、それらの差額の累積総額に、過去の借入れに対して支払うべき利息を加えたものです。

segments.src: In recent years, the annual shortfall has stayed large even though the economy has been growing and unemployment has been relatively low.
segments.tr: 近年では、経済が成長し失業率が比較的低い状態にあったにもかかわらず、毎年の歳入不足額は高止まりしたままとなっています。

segments.src: That is unusual by historical standards.
segments.tr: これは歴史的基準から見ると異例のことです。

segments.src: Deficits typically shrink in good economic times.
segments.tr: 通常、経済が良い時期には赤字は縮小するものだからです。

segments.src: ## Interest costs are now a major driver
segments.tr: ## 利払い費が現在主な要因となっている

segments.src: The biggest change in the budget picture is the cost of servicing the debt.
segments.tr: 予算の全体像における最大の変化は、債務の元利返済にかかるコストです。

segments.src: Net interest payments, meaning what the government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, have climbed sharply.
segments.tr: 純利払い費、つまり政府が獲得する利息を差し引いた後に借入れに対して支払う金額が、急激に上昇しています。

segments.src: The causes are straightforward:
segments.tr: その原因は明確です。

segments.src: - **A larger debt.** More borrowed money means more interest owed, even at constant rates.
segments.tr: - **債務の増加。** 借入金が増えれば、金利が一定であっても支払うべき利息が増加します。

segments.src: - **Higher rates than in the 2010s.** Older, cheaper debt matures and is refinanced at today's higher yields.
segments.tr: - **2010年代よりも高い金利。** 古くて安価な債務が償還を迎え、現在のより高い利回りで借り換えられています。

segments.src: - **Rolling over short-term debt.** A large share of Treasury debt is short-dated, so it reprices quickly when rates change.
segments.tr: - **短期債の借り換え（ロールオーバー）。** 財務省証券のかなりの割合が短期のものであるため、金利が変動した際に迅速に価格が再設定されます。

segments.src: In CBO projections, net interest has surpassed spending on national defense and now rivals or exceeds major programs.
segments.tr: CBOの予測では、純利払いは国防費を上回り、主要なプログラムに匹敵するかそれを超える規模になっています。

segments.src: Interest is not a policy choice that Congress votes on each year.
segments.tr: 利息は、議会が毎年投票で決定するような政策的選択ではありません。

segments.src: It is a bill that comes due automatically.
segments.tr: それは自動的に支払わなければならない請求書なのです。

segments.src: ## What the tally means for taxes
segments.tr: ## 集計が税制に対して意味すること

segments.src: A persistent deficit does not by itself force a tax change in any given year.
segments.tr: 慢性的な赤字それ自体が、任意の年度において直ちに税制変更を強制するわけではありません。

segments.src: Washington can borrow from investors at auction.
segments.tr: ワシントンは市場入札を通じて投資家から借入れを行うことができます。

segments.src: But rising interest costs shrink the room for other priorities, and that shapes the tax debate in several ways:
segments.tr: しかし、利払い費の増加は他の優先事項のための余地を狭め、それがさまざまな形で税制論争を形作っています。

segments.src: 1. **Expiring and extended provisions.** When Congress considers extending tax provisions, the cost of doing so is scored against deficit projections. Larger baseline deficits make those trade-offs sharper.
segments.tr: 1. **期限切れとなる規定と延長される規定。** 議会が税制上の規定の延長を検討する際、そのコストは赤字予測に対して評価（スコアリング）されます。ベースラインの赤字が大きくなると、そうしたトレードオフがより鮮明になります。

segments.src: 2. **Revenue versus spending framing.** Some lawmakers argue that revenue must rise. Others argue that spending must fall or that growth will close the gap. The final tally is used by both sides.
segments.tr: 2. **歳入対歳出の枠組み。** 歳入が増加しなければならないと主張する議員もいれば、歳出が削減されなければならない、あるいは経済成長がその差を埋めると主張する議員もいます。最終的な集計は双方によって利用されます。

segments.src: 3. **Tariff revenue.** Customs duties have become a larger line item. Analysts disagree about how durable that revenue is, given legal challenges and changes in trade policy.
segments.tr: 3. **関税収入。** 関税収入はより大きな項目となっています。法的な異議申し立てや通商政策の変更を考慮すると、その歳入がどれほど持続可能であるかについてはアナリストの間で意見が分かれています。

segments.src: Individual taxpayers should not expect any immediate change from a single year's deficit number.
segments.tr: 個人の納税者は、単一年度の赤字の数値から即座の変化を期待すべきではありません。

segments.src: Changes come through legislation, which can take a long time.
segments.tr: 変化は法律を通じてもたらされるものであり、それには長い時間がかかることがあります。

segments.src: ## What it means for spending debates
segments.tr: ## 歳出論争にとっての意味

segments.src: Most of the budget is already committed.
segments.tr: 予算の大部分はすでに使い道が決められています。

segments.src: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and net interest account for a large majority of federal outlays.
segments.tr: 社会保障（Social Security）、医療保険（Medicare）、低所得者向け医療支援（Medicaid）、および純利払いが連邦歳出の大半を占めています。

segments.src: The part Congress sets annually, called discretionary spending, is a smaller slice.
segments.tr: 議会が毎年独自に設定する裁量歳出と呼ばれる部分は、より小さな割合にすぎません。

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: それは国防および研究、交通、教育などの非国防プログラムをカバーしています。

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: 利払い費が増加するにつれて、それらはその裁量枠と競合することになります。

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: 毎年の予算配分をめぐる争いは、いくつかの疑問を中心に展開すると予想されます。

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - 歳出上限やその他の財政ルールを使用すべきか？

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - 長期的な成長を鈍化させるために、どのプログラム（もしあれば）を調整すべきか？

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - 緊急歳出は予算内でどのように扱われるべきか？

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## 次期議会にとっての意味

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: 2027年1月に就任する次期議会は、この状況を引き継ぐことになります。

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: いくつかの問題が浮上する可能性が高いです。

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **政府資金の期限。** 年次予算案およびつなぎ予算措置の可能性。

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **債務上限。** 以前の法律でどのように設定されたかに応じて、借入権限が再び議論の的になる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **税と給付のトレードオフ。** 社会保障や医療保険における長期的な信託基金の不足は、その枯渇予定日が近づくにつれて注目を集めるでしょう。

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **更新された予測。** 新しいCBOのベースラインにより、あらゆる提案の出発点がリセットされます。

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## 自分で数字を読み解く方法

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: 最終的な数値が発表されたとき、いくつかの習慣が役立ちます。

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.
segments.tr: - **GDPと比較する。** 経済規模に対する割合としての赤字は、ドル額そのものよりも意味があります。

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **一時的な影響を切り分ける。** 支払日が週末になるなど、時期のずれによって財政年度間で歳出が移動することがあります。

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **プライマリー赤字と総赤字を見る。** プライマリー赤字は利息を除外したものです。ギャップのうちどれだけが現在の政策によるもので、どれだけが過去の借入れによるものかを示します。

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.
segments.tr: - **一次情報源を使用する。** 財務省、CBO、および行政管理予算局（OMB）は、データを無料で公開しています。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Economists differ about how worrying that is and what the right response should be.

segments.tr: Der Teil, den der Kongress jährlich festlegt, die sogenannten diskretionären Ausgaben, ist ein kleinerer Anteil.

segments.src: It covers defense and non-defense programs such as research, transportation and education.
segments.tr: Er deckt die Verteidigung und Programme außerhalb der Verteidigung wie Forschung, Transport und Bildung ab.

segments.src: As interest costs grow, they compete with that discretionary slice.
segments.tr: Wenn die Zinskosten steigen, konkurrieren sie mit diesem diskretionären Anteil.

segments.src: Expect the annual appropriations fights to center on a few questions:
segments.tr: Man kann davon ausgehen, dass sich die jährlichen Haushaltskämpfe auf einige Fragen konzentrieren werden:

segments.src: - Should spending caps or other fiscal rules be used?
segments.tr: - Sollten Ausgabenobergrenzen oder andere fiskalische Regeln verwendet werden?

segments.src: - Which programs, if any, should be adjusted to slow long-term growth?
segments.tr: - Welche Programme sollten gegebenenfalls angepasst werden, um das langfristige Wachstum zu verlangsamen?

segments.src: - How should emergency spending be treated within the budget?
segments.tr: - Wie sollten Notfallausgaben innerhalb des Haushalts behandelt werden?

segments.src: ## What it means for the next Congress
segments.tr: ## Was es für den nächsten Kongress bedeutet

segments.src: The next Congress, which takes office in January 2027, will inherit this picture.
segments.tr: Der nächste Kongress, der sein Amt im Januar 2027 antritt, wird dieses Bild erben.

segments.src: Several issues are likely to come up:
segments.tr: Mehrere Themen werden wahrscheinlich zur Sprache kommen:

segments.src: - **Government funding deadlines.** Annual appropriations and the possibility of stopgap measures.
segments.tr: - **Fristen für die Regierungsfinanzierung.** Jährliche Bewilligungen und die Möglichkeit von Übergangsmaßnahmen.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Depending on how earlier legislation set it, borrowing authority may become a topic again.
segments.tr: - **Die Schuldenobergrenze.** Je nachdem, wie frühere Gesetze sie festgelegt haben, könnte die Kreditaufnahmegenehmigung wieder ein Thema werden.

segments.src: - **Tax and entitlement trade-offs.** Longer-term trust fund shortfalls in Social Security and Medicare will draw attention as their projected depletion dates approach.
segments.tr: - **Steuer- und Leistungsabwägungen.** Längerfristige Defizite in den Treuhandfonds von Social Security und Medicare werden Aufmerksamkeit erregen, wenn ihre prognostizierten Erschöpfungsdaten näher rücken.

segments.src: - **Updated projections.** New CBO baselines will reset the starting point for every proposal.
segments.tr: - **Aktualisierte Prognosen.** Neue CBO-Basisliniendaten werden den Ausgangspunkt für jeden Vorschlag neu setzen.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers yourself
segments.tr: ## So lesen Sie die Zahlen selbst

segments.src: When the final figures appear, a few habits help:
segments.tr: Wenn die endgültigen Zahlen vorliegen, helfen einige Gewohnheiten:

segments.src: - **Compare against GDP.** A deficit as a share of the economy is more meaningful than the dollar amount alone.
segments.tr: - **Vergleich mit dem BIP.** Ein Defizit als Anteil an der Wirtschaft ist aussagekräftiger als der Dollartrag allein.

segments.src: - **Separate one-time effects.** Timing shifts, such as when a payment date falls on a weekend, can move spending between fiscal years.
segments.tr: - **Einmalige Effekte herausrechnen.** Zeitliche Verschiebungen, wie etwa wenn ein Zahlungsdatum auf ein Wochenende fällt, können Ausgaben zwischen Haushaltsjahren verschieben.

segments.src: - **Look at primary versus total deficit.** The primary deficit excludes interest. It shows how much of the gap is due to current policy and how much is due to past borrowing.
segments.tr: - **Primärdefizit von Gesamtdefizit trennen.** Das Primärdefizit schließt Zinsen aus. Es zeigt, wie viel der Lücke auf die aktuelle Politik und wie viel auf vergangene Kredite zurückzuführen ist.

segments.src: - **Use original sources.** The Treasury, CBO and the Office of Management and Budget publish their data free of charge.
segments.tr: - **Originalquellen nutzen.** Das Finanzministerium, das CBO und das Amt für Verwaltung und Haushalt (OMB) veröffentlichen ihre Daten kostenlos.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The 2026 deficit tally is a snapshot of a longer pattern: spending commitments that exceed revenue, with interest costs adding to the pressure.
segments.tr: Das Defizitergebnis für 2026 ist eine Momentaufnahme eines längeren Musters: Ausgabenverpflichtungen, die die Einnahmen übersteigen, wobei Zinskosten den Druck erhöhen.

segments.src: Economists differ about how worrying that is and what the right response should be.
segments.tr: Ökonomen sind sich uneins darüber, wie besorgniserregend dies ist und wie die richtige Reaktion aussehen sollte.

segments.src: What most agree on is that the arithmetic gets harder as interest takes a larger share of the budget.
segments.tr: Worüber sich die meisten einig sind, ist, dass die Arithmetik schwieriger wird, da Zinsen einen größeren Teil des Haushalts einnehmen.
